review_scope: Complete LaTeX human proof, correspondence with the independently reviewed frozen Lean source, complete README and VERIFICATION documentation, engineering-claim cross-check, and visual inspection of every final PDF page. Public eligibility and publication authorization remain outside this review.

human_proof_review.support_size_symmetry_generation_and_exa: Proved directly from the actual support and transition probabilities.
human_proof_review.stochasticity_uniform_stationarity_and_i: Full normalization, symmetry/detailed balance, uniform mass, positive two-step paths, and stochastic matrix powers are justified.
human_proof_review.complete_character_basis: Actual factor characters are exhaustively classified, then orthogonality and dimension prove completeness. Matrix action is computed from the increment law.
human_proof_review.spectral_multiplicities: The complete spectra and characteristic polynomials of both P and actual I-P are derived. Strict root ordering gives ordinary gap 1/N, minimum transition multiplicity N-1, and minimum positive complement multiplicity 1.
human_proof_review.actual_matrix_powers: The coordinate-matrix recurrence is derived by matrix multiplication, all four closed coefficients satisfy it, and the initial identity matrix establishes the formula by induction.
human_proof_review.actual_total_variation: Both sign inequalities and all four coordinate cases are checked before summing absolute deviations. Time zero and every starting state are included.
human_proof_review.actual_least_mixing_times: Positive-tolerance threshold sets are shown nonempty, with attainment and minimality. The high threshold equals one and Bernoulli gives the divergent quarter-time lower bound.
human_proof_review.cutoff_negation: The genuine positive threshold window equals T-1, giving a ratio tending to one. Quantified standard TV cutoff separately fails at epsilon=1/4.
human_proof_review.universal_refutation_step: The report explicitly explains why the fully certified concrete family refutes the universal sufficient direction and why the necessary direction need not be resolved.
human_proof_review.profile_assumption_discharge: The report accurately identifies intermediate profile-parameter lemmas and their discharge using worstTV_eq in the closed capstones.
human_proof_review.finite_computation_status: Correctly supplementary; finite regression is not used as an unbounded or asymptotic proof.

resolved_review_correction.issue: The human quantified cutoff ratio needed explicit eventual positivity of its denominator at general fixed tolerances.
resolved_review_correction.resolution: Final Definition 2.1 now states the exact range 0<epsilon<1/2, positivity once N>1/(2epsilon), the initial-distance justification, and irrelevance of finite initial division conventions. This agrees with Lean's total real division.

engineering_evidence_cross_check.supplementary_clean_context_documentatio: A separate narrow check found no mathematical/count mismatch. Its evidence-granularity questions about exact capstone axioms, exact dependency revision, and regression details were resolved here by inspecting the actual audit entries, previously reviewed frozen manifest, and full regression script.

citation_check.author_and_title: David A. Levin, Cutoff for Markov Chains
citation_check.definition_verified: The cited page states the equivalent fixed-tolerance ratio criterion. The report correctly limits the citation to that convention and discloses its non-strict threshold convention.

interpretation_limits: The result refutes the explicit numerical sufficient condition under ordinary spectral gap and standard discrete-time total variation, not every possible mixing metric or arbitrary window convention.

The source's conditional spectral gap, second-order behavior, and unspecified comparison characterization remain undefined and unformalized; no unstated additional restriction is claimed to have been refuted.
The actual characters are those of the group generated by the support. The support is proved to generate the entire finite abelian state group; it is not treated as a group itself.
The minimum nontrivial transition eigenvalue and smallest positive I-P eigenvalue are distinct interpretations with separately derived actual root multiplicities.
The four formal implication negations concern the concrete certified family; the report explains the witness-to-universal-refutation step.

Compilation and closure checks are relative to the supplied pinned runtime and imported artifacts, without a full library rebuild, Lean bootstrap, provenance authentication, or second independent proof kernel.
Local verification and agent reviews do not constitute maintainer acceptance.
